task.description:
REWORK 1: Fix 1 MAJOR lint issue in integration test.

ISSUE: lint_test_isolation.py reports MAJOR on tests/integration/iss201_transition_result_test.zig:29 — hardcoded UUID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099 used as creator_uuid_str constant.

FIX: Replace the compile-time constant with a runtime randomUuidStr() call inside the test function. This is the `created_by` field for definition creation — use the same `try randomUuidStr(allocator)` pattern as ISS-101/ISS-102/ISS-107 tests use for their fixture IDs. After fixing, run python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration and confirm no MAJOR on the ISS-201 file.

Do NOT modify any other files or test logic.
